The '''Bizikia system''' was an [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Kwymar sector/Legends|Kwymar sector]].<ref name="EAOC" /> The system was home to the [[Species/Legends|creatures]] known as [[Bizikian hornet]]s.<ref name="Siege" /><ref name="Planetnamia" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Bizikia system was established in the [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] to the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', which placed the system in grid square P-4.<ref name="EAOC" />
